author: RallySense Lab engineering review; human security approval pending

statements.action_statement: Unpatched go-jose/v3 3.0.5 is present. Proposed applicability reasoning is limited to this reverse-proxy configuration: admin disabled, no acme_server/JWK/JWT endpoint, private CA/key material controlled locally. Obtain explicit human disposition; invalidate on config/module changes. This statement must not suppress the scanner finding.

Debian confirms installed stable libxml2 affected; no compatible stable vendor patch is available. PostgreSQL remains private and the application exposes no arbitrary SQL/XML interface. Require vendor update or explicit human acceptance for both release modes; do not label the library not affected.

Mode B blocked: actual required MOV/PSSH parsing hit the 20-second application timeout on a generated 1.65 MB file. Readonly image omits native media. Require supported patch or separately reviewed stronger processing isolation.

Mode B blocked pending native Matroska HDR10+ serialization applicability/patch review. Upstream fix is referenced but no accepted supported stable release containing it was established. No not-affected claim.
